C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 174
Date. 17/3/19

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

March 16th 1919.

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang has received a telegram from Soochow saying that it is feared that about 1,000 troops stationed in the vicinity of Quinsan will mutiny in the near future. In consequence of this General Yang has given instructions to the military and police officers in Shanghai to take special precautions.
It is rumoured that Yuen Shih Kai's eldest son arrived at the Arsenal yesterday.
It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities have received information that several rebels are coming to Shanghai from Europe by the s.s. Niashin Maru".
Five robbers convicted for offences in Chinese territory were shot at the Arsenal yesterday afternoon.
It is reported that an Anhui man named "Ong Ts Kong 王志剛 has been sent here by the Central Government to take Liu's place as head of the assassination Corps. Wong will establish his headquarters at No.4, 767 Yui Yu Lee 有餘里 Kyung Oo Road 共和路 Chapei where Liu is at present.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on ind. March 16.
Seen by C.I.D.

刑事调查处
情报官登记
第 174 号
日期：1919 年 3 月 17 日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1919 年 3 月 16 日。

先生：

据报，杨将军收到来自苏州的电报，称担心驻扎在昆山附近的约 1,000 名士兵在不久的将来会发生兵变。因此，杨将军已指示上海的军警官员采取特别预防措施。

有谣言称，袁世凯的长子昨日抵达兵工厂。

据报，兵工厂当局收到消息，几名反叛分子将乘坐“新清丸”号轮船（s.s. Niashin Maru）从欧洲前来上海。

昨日下午，五名因在中国地界犯罪而被定罪的抢劫犯在兵工厂被枪决。

据报，一名名为“Ong Ts Kong 王志剛”的安徽人已被中央政府派往此处，接替刘氏担任暗杀团首领。王将在闸北共和路有余里 767 号 4 室设立总部，该处目前为刘氏所在地。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

于 3 月 16 日录入索引。
刑事调查处已阅。
